description.text: The Charizard deck of Garchomp VS Charizard, a Versus Starter Pack SP released on 6 March 2009 with the Beat of the Frontier expansion. It pits Sinnoh's Champion Cynthia against Cyrus, the boss of Team Galactic: one deck of Champion Pokémon marked C, led by Garchomp C LV.X, and one of Team Galactic's Pokémon marked G, led by Charizard G LV.X, with four holo cards between them and each side's own Trainer card. Damage counters and markers, a coin and a how-to-play book came with it.
